chapter: From Dusk to Dawn in Byakuyakoku

quests.title: The Entrance to Tokoyo

dialogue.t: Phew, it sure took a while before we saw anything resembling civilization. Let's get closer and have a look.
The five symbols on this big door must be the Key Sigils.
Let's have a look around. From what we've experienced in the past, we'll probably need to do something else first.
Wow! Paimon never thought that there'd be such a huge place underneath Watatsumi Island!
Looks like our goal is that place in the middle.
Alrighty then, {NICKNAME}. Let's head in. Steadily now...
Those ruins seem to be closer to us. Let's start there!
Buildings means people... once upon a time, anyway. And where there's people, there'll be writing!
And where there's writing and paper, there'll be those... hints that we can't even read.

quests.description: After passing through The Moon-Bathed Deep, you come to a land that is foreign to you. You see no sign of any civilization at all, and so you decide to investigate further.
